title: BeamMessage
description: Shared schema for BEAM messages exchanged between the Erlang/AtomVM runtime (mcpp) and the wasm4pm TypeScript swarm. This is the canonical source of truth — both sides of the protocol must comply. Any message shape change MUST update this file first.

PidString.description: Erlang/AtomVM process identifier in string form: pid:<node.serial.creation>

RefString.description: Erlang/AtomVM reference in string form: ref:<node.creation.serial1.serial2>

BeamMsg.title: BeamMsg
BeamMsg.description: A message sent from one BEAM process to another. Used for route_eval, swarm consensus evidence, gap reports, and activity notifications.

tag.description: Message discriminant — always 'beam_msg' for inter-process messages.

payload.description: Message body. Structure depends on the payload type field; the schema intentionally leaves this open so new payload types can be added without a breaking schema change.

sent_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the message was dispatched.

BeamMonitor.title: BeamMonitor
BeamMonitor.description: A process monitor notification from AtomVM/Erlang. Emitted when a monitored process changes state (DOWN, UP, EXIT).

tag.description: Message discriminant — always 'beam_monitor' for monitor notifications.

ref.description: Monitor reference that was established via erlang:monitor/2.

event.description: Monitor event type. DOWN = process terminated, UP = process (re)started, EXIT = process exited with linked reason.

reason.description: Exit reason string (e.g. 'normal', 'noproc', 'timeout', 'killed'). Corresponds to the Reason term in {'DOWN', Ref, process, Pid, Reason}.

pid.description: Process identifier of the monitored process that changed state.

at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the monitor event was recorded.
